## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user need and what changes.

## Specification

Link the affected specification and numbered acceptance criteria. Record any new assumptions before changing behavior.

## Verification

State the checks actually run and their results. Financial model changes need an independent reference or meaningful property check. Distinguish browser checks from HTTP tests and list material checks not performed.

## Data and release impact

Describe changes to privacy, model/schema versions, migration, saved plans, dependencies or hosting. Keep credentials, runtime databases, keyrings and personal financial records out of the change.
